Results and verificationMethods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Finite Dirichlet boxes and central differences; whole-line HO formulas do not isolate finite-wall error. Node counts diagnostic until forward sign qualification. Atomic model units hbar=m=1 and HO omega=1. The box[0,1] and finite HO[-L,L] domains both use homogeneous Dirichlet conditions. Editorial clarification Eight full solves save824raw pairs; qualification applies to24selected pairs. Thresholded nodes/phase are diagnostics. HO0.003 is a met fixed-case goal, not a proved bound; finite-wall/mesh sensitivities do not certify separate errors. Adopted numerical method Use centered differences and eight full NumPy eigensolves, saving824 native pairs before selecting24 low pairs.
